messages:
Mia Chen: quick heads-up — Freyr Labs QBR prep. saw a big spend spike last 7d and their credit balance is low. want to align on cost playbook + capture product feedback for prompt inefficiencies. pinging FinOps + eng ops.
Sam Patel: got it. can you drop the 7d numbers here so I can scope a short-term credit top-up vs quota?
Mia Chen: sure — snapshot from billing: ```
7d_total_tokens: 3,200,412
7d_est_cost: $4,815.60
baseline_weekly_cost: $1,180.00
credits_remaining: 12% (~$120k value)
unusual_calls: 2 endpoints (chat+embedding) spiking
```
Jordan Reyes: renewal in ~6w. risk looks elevated if we don't show runway. customer says they're testing larger contexts for a new feature.
Lee Nguyen: agree medium-high. ops suggestions: temporary rate limit on embed route, enroll them in a short enablement session on batching + quantized models. also schedule a proactive credits top-up to avoid interruption.
Sam Patel: proposed short fix: apply a soft throttle at 25rps for embedding-heavy api_key and add a billing alert at 80% credits. Example alert rule: ```if credits_pct < 20% && spend_rate > 2x baseline -> notify cs+finance```
Mia Chen: I'll open the customer enablement invite and attach the sample prompts we saw that are causing long contexts. also will file a ticket for product to investigate prompt/template inefficiencies (capture: sample convo + token counts).
Jordan Reyes: can we include an ROI note for the QBR — show potential savings by batching + switching to a smaller embedding model? need numbers by EOD Thu.
Sam Patel: I'll run a quick delta calc: batching x5 -> est cost down ~40%, switching to emb-small ~30% delta. will post a short table by 3pm.
Lee Nguyen: action items: 1) Mia -> enablement invite + attach samples (today) 2) Sam -> delta cost estimates + alert config (3pm) 3) Jordan -> renewal impact summary + stakeholder ask (EOD Thu) 4) Mia -> create product ticket with examples (now)
Mia Chen: done — created ticket CS-4821 in internal tracker and added sample prompts + token dump. tagging @eng-models for prompt optimization triage.
cs-bot: Reminder: Freyr Labs runbook created (CS-4821). Next check-in scheduled in 48h. :calendar: 
Jordan Reyes: thanks team. quick question — do we want to offer a short-term credits grant or a usage-based promo to smooth renewal?
Sam Patel: recommend short-term grant enough for 2 wks of baseline + buffer, conditional on enablement session completion. I'll draft wording.
Mia Chen: ok. I'll include that in the QBR packet as a one-time goodwill offer and link to enablement recording after session.
Lee Nguyen: capturing feedback loop: post-session, we'll collect a 3-question survey (on model choice, prompt templates, observability) and route answers to product.
Mia Chen: perfect. I'll update CS-4821 with survey template. closing this thread once Sam posts numbers. :white_check_mark:
